mainEntity.name: When should my business consider implementing Service Area Optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your business should consider implementing Service Area Optimization if you primarily serve customers within specific geographic boundaries, rather than a nationwide or global audience. This is particularly relevant for local service providers, brick-and-mortar stores, or businesses with sales territories. If you rely on local clients to grow, or if you're struggling to attract customers from nearby communities, SAO can provide the targeted visibility you need. The best time to start is as soon as you define your service regions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider SAO if your business serves specific local areas. It's ideal for local service providers and businesses aiming to attract customers from defined communities.
